question: cp-9 中系统组件参数代表什么？

contexts.text:

[cp-9_smt.b] Conduct backups of system-level information contained in the system {{ insert: param, cp-09_odp.03 }};
[cp-9_smt.c] Conduct backups of system documentation, including security- and privacy-related documentation {{ insert: param, cp-09_odp.04 }} ; and
[cp-9_smt.d] Protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of backup information.
[cp-9_gdn] System-level information includes system state information, operating system software, middleware, application software, and licenses. User-level information includes information other than system-level information. Mechanisms employed to protect the integrity of system backups include digital signatures and cryptographic hashes. Organizations may be subject to laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, or policies with requirements regarding specific categories of information (e.g., personal health information).
